verdict: ROAS is healthy, but purchase volume is too thin and needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5.36 for every $1 spent — a strong efficiency number — but that return is built on just 39 purchases total, and purchase volume dropped 50% in the most recent week. Day-to-day revenue is highly uneven, with some days producing zero sales despite consistent daily spend around $55–60, which points to a thin creative pool that we're actively addressing. Google Business Profile engagement also fell sharply this week, and we're closing a posting gap there to restore organic visibility alongside your paid activity. Several project milestones — including the subscribe-page funnel test and platform setup tasks — are being resolved now ahead of the September 30 deliverable deadlines. Next week you should see more consistency in daily purchase activity as creative is refreshed and the attribution setup is tightened.

watch_item.issue: Purchase volume is dropping day to day, with multiple zero-revenue days despite steady ad spend — the creative pool is thin and revenue tracking has a known gap.
watch_item.fix: Ad creative is being refreshed this week and purchase tracking through the store is being corrected to ensure every sale is recorded accurately.
